title: API Testing
description: Roles and Responsibilities Lead end-to-end quality engineering for REST APIs, from requirements analysis to production validation for 5-9 years' scale projects. Design, implement, and maintain robust API test strategies covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing. Drive API test automation frameworks and suites, ensuring high coverage, reliability, and maintainability across services and microservices. Collaborate with architects and developers to review API specifications (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI), ensuring testability, consistency, and adherence to standards. Define and enforce best practices for API testing, automation, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines. Analyze complex defects and production issues, perform root cause analysis, and work with cross-functional teams to implement long-term fixes. Mentor and guide junior QA/automation engineers on API testing techniques, tools, and automation patterns. Additional Responsibilities Good to Have Skills: API design review, Contract testing, Performance testing, CI/CD integration, Agile methodologies Technical Requirements Extensive experience in API test automation, including building and maintaining automation suites for REST APIs. Demonstrated ability to define test strategies, test plans, and quality processes for complex, distributed systems. Experience integrating automated API tests into CI/CD pipelines and working in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong background in overall Testing practices, including test design techniques, risk-based testing, and regression optimization. Proven track record of leading small to medium QA/automation teams, providing technical guidance and code reviews for test assets. Ability to analyze logs, traces, and API responses to quickly diagnose issues and support root cause analysis. You'll collaborate closely with architects, developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to build robust test strategies that keep pace with modern, cloud-native delivery. This is an opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and introduce smarter ways of working-using automation, metrics, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy solving intricate integration challenges, designing scalable API test frameworks, and leading teams toward engineering excellence, this role gives you the platform to make a visible impact while growing as a technology leader. title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. You've pushed back on a release, or on a requirement that would confuse users, and been right. Lifting others. Test reviews, docs or mentoring that made developers and newer SDETs better at quality. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You test the way customers actually work, and you treat every escaped bug and support ticket as a lesson. Impact over activity. You measure success by bugs that never reached customers and releases that went out smoothly, not test-case counts. Honesty. You report quality as it is, say clearly what wasn't tested, and raise release risks even when it's unwelcome. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to test. You find the risk worth covering and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built, a technique you went deep on, things you taught others. Depth. At least one system you've tested well enough to explain its internals, its failure modes and how you'd test them. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. title: Software Technical Consulting Engineer
description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: As a Software Technical Consulting Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in enabling software developers to succeed with Intel platforms. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve providing hands-on technical assistance, supporting developers in optimizing software applications, and delivering impactful training sessions. By leveraging your expertise, you will directly contribute to the success of Intel's AI solutions and development tools empowering innovation. Business Group: The Software Technical Consulting Engineer role is part of the Data Center Software team. Join a group focused on solving meaningful technical challenges and shaping the future of software development for AI, and beyond. Key Responsibilities: Own technical support and provide hands-on deployment help to strategic customers on Enterprise AI (RAG, inference), Intel developer tools(Compilers, Libraries), and related software solutions for US, EMEA and APAC customers. Serve as a primary support-queue owner for customer intake, environment collection, installation and access issues, baseline troubleshooting, issue reproduction, and customer communications. Partner with peers for complex issues, including deeper troubleshooting, issue reproduction, workaround development, and workload or product-specific analysis. Support customer deployment and getting-started requests, maintain case ownership against defined SLAs, and convert recurring/resolved issues into FAQs, known issues, and reusable support documentation. Coordinate with named engineering owners on engineering disposition, workarounds, fixes, and release plans while maintaining customer communication through closure. Help develop and adopt AI-assisted support workflows using existing capabilities for activities such as case summarization, routing, duplicate detection, knowledge suggestions, draft responses, backlog reporting, and identification of stale cases or SLA risk, with human review of customer-facing actions. Help track support metrics such as response time, backlog health, escalation aging, and customer-update cadence. The Poland location provides EMEA coverage with useful overlap into APAC and AMR time zones. Partner across Customer Success, product specialists, engineering, product teams, IT, and account teams to provide a consistent support experience and ensure customer learnings flow back into product improvements and documentation. Qualifications: Required qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5 years of experience in customer-facing technical support or support engineering, ideally involving developer tools and direct interaction with customers. Understanding of the end-to-end support lifecycle, including request intake, issue triage, prioritization, investigation, escalation, customer communication, and closure. Working knowledge of compilers, libraries, analyzers, or related software development tools, with the ability to investigate customer issues and coordinate with technical experts. Solid understanding of software development principles and practical familiarity with Python and C++ for troubleshooting, reproducing issues, and validating solutions. Familiarity with AI deployment fundamentals, including RAG, inference, and LLM APIs. Ability to manage multiple customer cases, track ownership and progress, maintain clear documentation, and follow through to resolution. Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate across teams in a fast-paced technical environment. Preferred qualifications: Experience with Intel Software Development tools: Intel Compilers(C++/DPC++), Libraries(MPI, oneMKL, IPP), Profilers (VTune/SEP/EMON), debuggers or cluster schedulers. Working knowledge of compilers and the build/run toolchain (C/C++, Fortran or DPC++). Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions Hands-on experience building or tuning AI agents, prompt workflows or MCP or tool-calling integrations for triage. Experience with case-management systems, knowledge bases, escalation procedures, and service-level expectations. Experience identifying recurring customer issues and recommending improvements to support workflows, documentation, and self-service resources. Customer-facing experience with strategic or scale accounts. Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India) Primary Location: India, Bangalore Additional Locations: Posting Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Under summary section Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come! Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role: PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS. Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause. Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries. Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause. Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure. Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality. Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis) What do you need to bring: 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing. Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other. Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures. Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries. Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail. Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers. Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. Our Benefits: At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. Who We Are: Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. Belonging at PayPal: Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

Experience creating architecture designs that incorporate resiliency and performance. Success at achieving sophisticated technology goals on-time and on-budget. A comfort level with complex, matrixed organizations containing a certain amount of ambiguity. Experience leading teams supporting enterprise-scale solutions from both business and technical perspectives. Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills. The position requires frequent communication with executives, colleagues and partners in several different geographic locations and time zones. Proven ability to work with all members of an extended and diverse project team. Experience using JIRA for estimation, tracking team velocity, and managing stories and issues. Must be detail-oriented, self-organized, committed to quality and capable of tracking multiple issues simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to an evolving landscape. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
